svg.text: Solderless Raspberry Pi Zero 2 W kill-switch panel - wiring reference
NEVER CONNECT 5V TO ANY GPIO PIN
Internal 3.3V pull-up enabled in SOFTWARE | NO external resistor
Open / broken circuit = HIGH = HALT the agent fleet
GPIO -> 1k -> node | node -> 100uF -> GND | node -> meter V+ | meter- -> GND
one 330R per channel | GPIO5->R GPIO6->G GPIO22->B
Endpoints labeled GPIOxx / phys yy. No 5V net ever meets a GPIO endpoint.
